title: Source
description: Capture Truth 0.5-compatible metadata-only source record. Source bodies stay in their system of record; raw-like keys (content, body, raw, raw_body, raw_content/rawContent, payload, document, data), including case variants and recursively nested fields/metadata keys, are rejected by runtime privacy validation. JSON Schema enforces the canonical shape; URL credential semantics and case-insensitive recursive key checks remain runtime validations. raw_included is optional provenance metadata indicating that a capture record held a body in its system of record; it is never itself a body. observed_at records when evidence was observed or snapshotted; source_updated_at records the source-reported last modification. Capture provenance extensions (kind, adapter, key, locator, access_caveats, fields, raw_included) are accepted without permitting source bodies.

id.description: Stable identifier for the source record within the artifact.

kind.description: Capture kind when the record came from a capture component.

type.description: Source kind: jira, decision-log, meeting-note, or any explicit label.

adapter.description: Capture adapter that produced the record.

key.description: Capture key within the adapter (for example the ticket key).

url.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL to the source of record.

path.description: Optional file path for local sources.

observed_at.description: When the evidence was observed or snapshotted. Full RFC3339 datetime with Z or UTC offset. Age from as_of raises stale_observation when it exceeds max_observation_age_days.

source_updated_at.description: Last-modified time reported by the source system; full RFC3339 datetime with Z or UTC offset. Age from as_of raises stale_source_content when it exceeds max_source_content_age_days; its interval after observed_at is the snapshot gap.

owner.description: Human or team accountable for this source record.

revision.description: Optional source revision at capture time.

content_hash.description: Optional sha256 content hash in canonical 64-hex form, with or without a sha256: prefix.

locator.description: Concrete pointer (URL, path, key) to the source of record.

access_caveats.description: Capture caveats about access to the source.

fields.description: Structured fields extracted by capture; never the raw body or a recursively nested raw-body field.

metadata.description: Optional capture metadata; raw-body fields are rejected recursively.

raw_included.description: Optional provenance metadata: whether the capture record held a raw body in its system of record. The body itself never travels in this artifact; raw_included is metadata only and never treated as a raw body.
